release_notes: Promote the authoritative FOODEX main lineage after the completed 1.0.74 Dashboard update into synchronized release 1.0.75. Preserve the full Customer VNext program and Mobile Smart Store Analytics stack already integrated on main, including Retail EGP analytics, Dashboard-managed store branding, compact mobile analytics UI, insight badge/pulse behavior, production launch controls, protected reset/reseed, and final certification gates. Rebuild the Dashboard update and Customer, Driver and Van Android artifacts from one exact release lineage with mobile source identity 1.0.75+75. Keep production Launch/reset safeguards fail-closed; release promotion does not bypass owner-data, asset, backup, migration or green-preflight requirements. Dashboard update targets direct upgrade from 1.0.74 while retaining the cumulative updater boundary.
